dslRule:
<!id: use-linkedhashset-for-ordered-set-history>
<!description: Replace HashSet with LinkedHashSet when insertion order must be preserved, typically for history lists or ordered caches. LinkedHashSet provides predictable iteration order.
>
<!severity: HINT>
new java.util.HashSet($args$)
=>
new java.util.LinkedHashSet($args$)
;;
summary: Replace `new HashSet()` with `new LinkedHashSet()` to maintain insertion order for history-like collections.
